name: Layan Verde
shortDescription: Large phased resort condominium of 776 units by VillaCarte near Layan Beach, from studios to five-bedroom pool residences.
description:
Layan Verde is one of the largest new residential schemes on Phuket's west coast: 776 units in seven-storey buildings on a site of about 7.7 hectares, roughly 700 m to 1 km inland from Layan Beach. The developer, VillaCarte Group, is building it in phases with completion planned for 2028.
The unit range is unusually wide. It starts with studios of about 39 sqm and one- to three-bedroom apartments, and goes up to "luxury" units with private pools and four- and five-bedroom residences of 400 to 630 sqm. Over 40% of the land is kept for landscaping and shared facilities, which include several pools, a fitness centre, spa, restaurants and a cafe, co-working space, a kids' area and a sky garden.
The Laguna golf course and Boat Avenue are about 10 minutes away and the airport about 20 minutes. Some units are sold in the foreign freehold quota and others on leasehold, so check the title of each unit. Rental-return programmes advertised for this project are not shown here.
